arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
# hostile long-string address forms must now be rejected instantly
import json, subprocess, time
def run(lines):
    data = ''.join(lines)
    t=time.time()
    p = subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=data.encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=60)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr[-800:]
    return [json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.decode().splitlines()], time.time()-t
good = json.dumps({"op":"compile","fib":[],"capacities":[4096]*4,"max_stride":32})+'\n'
img = json.loads(open('/app/examples/sample.image.json').read())
hostile = [
  # long "address-like" strings that would be slow to parse without the bound
  '{"op":"lookup","image":' + json.dumps(img) + ',"addresses":["' + '0:'*15000000 + '0"]}',
  '{"op":"lookup","image":' + json.dumps(img) + ',"addresses":["' + '0000:'*8000000 + '0"]}',
  '{"op":"compile","fib":[{"prefix":"' + '0:'*15000000 + '0/32","hop":1}],"capacities":[4096]*4,"max_stride":32}',
  # image rule with a giant prefix string
  '{"op":"lookup","image":{"status":"ok","capacities":[4096,4096,4096,4096],"max_stride":32,"cuts":[0,32,64,96,128],"stages":[{"nodes":[{"prefix":"::/0","rules":[{"prefix":"' + '0'*30000000 + '/0","hop":1}],"edges":[]}]}] + [],"used_bits":[128,0,0,0],"peak":{"num":1,"den":32}},"addresses":[]}',
]
for h in hostile:
    out, dt = run([h + '\n', good])
    assert out[0] == {'status':'invalid'}, out[0]
    assert out[1]['status'] == 'ok'
    print('len=%8d rejected in %.2fs' % (len(h), dt))
print('LONG STRING HOSTILE TESTS PASSED')
EOF
